review.notes: Full review. All 8 findings of the previous review are repaired. Gate passes (every check 0, build=0); depcheck 244 roadmaps, 2197 edges, 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with 35 sorry warnings and nothing else; one-tactic padding probe closes none of the 35. 20 library declarations opened at the pins and 24 more located by name; supplier citations resolved on main. Findings: R01 (P2) README 4.3/4.4/6.1 omit the countably-many-relation-symbols hypothesis the Lean carries (counterexample with uncountably many unary predicates); R02 (P3) scope table inputs for Layers 5 and 6; R03 (P3) description says 38 sorry warnings, head has 35. Kechris, Gao, Keisler and Marker 2016 not readable (paywalled).
